facts.title: 我方服务范围
facts.questionVariants: your role|mediator|middleman|what do you provide|why work with you
facts.keywords: your role|mediator|middleman|what do you provide|why work with you
facts.answer: Our team supports initial review, enterprise matching, application preparation, submission coordination and subsequent administrative assistance. Experts are not charged for these services.

facts.title: 多代理及材料保护
facts.questionVariants: other agency|duplicate agency|protect my rights|material misuse
facts.keywords: other agency|duplicate agency|protect my rights|material misuse
facts.answer: Duplicate applications should be avoided. Where authorisation verification is required, the expert should be informed of its exact purpose before providing it. No guarantee of selection or subsidy payment should be made.

facts.title: 个人或团队申报
facts.questionVariants: apply individually|apply jointly|as a team|with my team|research partner
facts.keywords: apply individually|apply jointly|as a team|with my team|research partner
facts.answer: Candidates may apply individually or jointly and may participate with relevant research or entrepreneurial partners.

facts.title: 申报条件与材料（停用）
facts.questionVariants: criteria|qualification|eligible|requirements
facts.keywords: criteria|qualification|eligible|requirements
facts.answer: Applicants should hold the title of associate professor or above, have outstanding research achievements and be able to contribute to industrial services and scientific and technological innovation.

facts.title: 初审材料
facts.questionVariants: send CV|initial materials|what should I provide|documents needed|provide my CV
facts.keywords: send CV|initial materials|what should I provide|documents needed|provide my CV
facts.answer: At the initial stage, a CV is sufficient for eligibility review and enterprise matching. Additional supporting materials may be requested later if the application proceeds.

facts.title: 后续支持材料
facts.questionVariants: patent certificate|publication list|supporting documents|additional materials
facts.keywords: patent certificate|publication list|supporting documents|additional materials
facts.answer: Patent information, publication lists, education records and other supporting evidence may be requested later according to application requirements. Original identity documents are not required for initial review.

facts.title: 申请步骤
facts.questionVariants: application process|next steps|procedure|what happens next
facts.keywords: application process|next steps|procedure|what happens next
facts.answer: After initial materials are received, the team conducts an eligibility review, begins enterprise matching, prepares application documents with the matched enterprise and submits the completed materials for review.

facts.title: 完整申请周期
facts.questionVariants: full cycle|application timeline|how long does the process take
facts.keywords: full cycle|application timeline|how long does the process take
facts.answer: The complete matching, application-preparation, submission and review process generally takes approximately six months or longer.

facts.title: 申报及公布窗口
facts.questionVariants: deadline|when to apply|submission deadline|submission window|when results
facts.keywords: deadline|when to apply|submission deadline|submission window|when results
facts.answer:
Materials are usually submitted around March-May, with results announced in November-December.

The exact submission deadline should be confirmed according to the latest project notice before application.

facts.title: 成功率及再次申报
facts.questionVariants: success rate|chance|probability|not selected|apply again
facts.keywords: success rate|chance|probability|not selected|apply again
facts.answer: This is a national-level project with an approximate success rate of about 10%. Competition is strong. If you are not selected in the first year, you may apply again in a subsequent cycle.

facts.title: 确认视频
facts.questionVariants: confirmation video|VCR|passport video|record a video|identity verification
facts.keywords: confirmation video|VCR|passport video|record a video|identity verification
facts.answer: Any identity-verification requirement, including a confirmation video, is handled by an operator only after clear interest and before formal submission. The exact requirement and safeguards must be explained before materials are requested.

facts.title: 入选后流程
facts.questionVariants: after selection|what happens after selected|onboarding|finalise project scope
facts.keywords: after selection|what happens after selected|onboarding|finalise project scope
facts.answer: After selection, the researcher and matched enterprise finalise the project scope and written agreement. Visits, onboarding and administrative support are then arranged according to the agreed collaboration.

facts.title: 护照及敏感证件顾虑
facts.questionVariants: share passport|passport privacy|identity document|sensitive documents
facts.keywords: share passport|passport privacy|identity document|sensitive documents
facts.answer: No passport or original identity document is required for initial review. If identity verification becomes necessary later, an operator must explain the requirement, safeguards and permitted redactions before requesting anything.

facts.title: 会议安排
facts.questionVariants: meeting|Zoom|Teams|Webex|schedule a call|time zone
facts.keywords: meeting|Zoom|Teams|Webex|schedule a call|time zone
facts.answer: Zoom, Teams or Webex may be used. A typical introductory call lasts approximately 15–20 minutes and is arranged according to the expert's time zone.

facts.title: 仅邮件联系
facts.questionVariants: email only|not on LinkedIn|no social media|contact me by email
facts.keywords: email only|not on LinkedIn|no social media|contact me by email
facts.answer: Understood. Communication may continue by email only.

facts.title: 项目敏感性
facts.questionVariants: sensitive programme|legitimacy|security concern|trust
facts.keywords: sensitive programme|legitimacy|security concern|trust
facts.answer: Caution is understandable. Communication may continue by email, and available company-registration and talent-office documentation may be provided for independent verification before the expert proceeds.

facts.title: 退休专家答复
facts.questionVariants: retired|I am retired|no longer working
facts.keywords: retired|I am retired|no longer working
facts.answer: Thank you for letting us know. We will not continue discussing participation. A referral may be requested only where appropriate and without pressure.

facts.title: 公司法定身份
facts.questionVariants: company name|legal name|registered location|registered address
facts.keywords: company name|legal name|registered location|registered address
facts.answer: Our registered company name is Jiangsu Qingfei Talent Technology Co., Ltd. (江苏清飞人才科技有限公司), registered in Nanjing, China.

facts.title: 公司官方网站
facts.questionVariants: company website|your website|official company website|company site
facts.keywords: company website|your website|official company website|company site
facts.answer: Our official company website is https://www.qingfeitalent.com.

facts.title: 清飞与政府人才办合作证明
facts.questionVariants: verify|proof|registration information|certificate|government cooperation|talent summit|policy documents
facts.keywords: verify|proof|registration information|certificate|government cooperation|talent summit|policy documents
facts.answer: Qingfei cooperates with local government talent offices in multiple regions. We can provide supporting evidence of these working relationships, including company registration information; supporting documents, policy materials and relevant certificates from local talent offices; records of official talent activities; and materials relating to government talent summits.

facts.title: 线上申请材料保密
facts.questionVariants: materials confidential|keep my documents|redaction|application privacy|confidentiality
facts.keywords: materials confidential|keep my documents|redaction|application privacy|confidentiality
facts.answer: Your materials are kept strictly confidential and used only for application purposes. Technical details you prefer not to disclose can be handled with appropriate redaction.

facts.title: 合同及签约主体
facts.questionVariants: contract terms|contractual relationship|written agreement|formal agreement|who signs|contracting party|partner company
facts.keywords: contract terms|contractual relationship|written agreement|formal agreement|who signs|contracting party|partner company
facts.answer: After selection, the expected arrangement is a written agreement directly between the expert and the matched enterprise, not Qingfei Tech Talent Team. The exact legal relationship, contract type and full terms must be confirmed for the specific project and reviewed before any commitment.

facts.title: 企业匹配原则
facts.questionVariants: matching process|how do you match|matched enterprise|research matching
facts.keywords: matching process|how do you match|matched enterprise|research matching
facts.answer: Enterprise matching is based on the expert's research background and the specific technical needs of potential Chinese partners; experts are not assigned to generic vacancies.

facts.title: 合作企业类型
facts.questionVariants: types of companies|companies typically work with|enterprise types|industries|partner types
facts.keywords: types of companies|companies typically work with|enterprise types|industries|partner types
facts.answer: There is no fixed public list of companies. The relevant company type and industry depend on the expert's research direction and the availability of a genuinely suitable partner.

facts.title: 常见研发需求
facts.questionVariants: R&D gaps|research gaps|technical needs|common problems|product development
facts.keywords: R&D gaps|research gaps|technical needs|common problems|product development
facts.answer: Potential enterprise needs may involve technical problem-solving, product development, research guidance or technology commercialisation. The specific need cannot be confirmed before an enterprise and project are identified.

facts.title: 匹配后的企业披露
facts.questionVariants: company profile|company address|matched company details|proposed technical work
facts.keywords: company profile|company address|matched company details|proposed technical work
facts.answer: Once a potential match is identified, the company profile, website, address and proposed technical work should be provided for the expert's review.

facts.title: 企业匹配期限
facts.questionVariants: timeline for matching|matching deadline|how long to match|matching time
facts.keywords: timeline for matching|matching deadline|how long to match|matching time
facts.answer: There is no fixed enterprise-matching deadline. Timing depends on the expert's research direction and the availability of a genuinely suitable enterprise.

facts.title: 专家费用政策
facts.questionVariants: fee|fees|charge|charges|cost|costs|money transfer
facts.keywords: fee|fees|charge|charges|cost|costs|money transfer
facts.answer: We never charge experts any fees throughout the process.

facts.title: 薪资待遇与政府科研经费
facts.questionVariants: government funding|research funding|3 million|12 million|project funding|salary support|housing allowance
facts.keywords: government funding|research funding|3 million|12 million|project funding|salary support|housing allowance
facts.answer: After a successful application, selected candidates may receive government research funding in the range of 3-12 million RMB, with enterprises providing personal salary support separately; full-time roles may also include additional housing allowance.

facts.title: 企业个人报酬
facts.questionVariants: salary|compensation|remuneration|advisory compensation|paid role|personal compensation
facts.keywords: salary|compensation|remuneration|advisory compensation|paid role|personal compensation
facts.answer: Personal compensation is provided separately by the matched enterprise under the agreed collaboration arrangement.

facts.title: 报酬结构
facts.questionVariants: compensation structure|retainer|hourly|project-based|payment method|payment schedule
facts.keywords: compensation structure|retainer|hourly|project-based|payment method|payment schedule
facts.answer: There is no universal compensation model. The exact amount, payment method, deliverables and payment schedule are negotiated and included in the written agreement before any commitment is made.

facts.title: 其他可能支持
facts.questionVariants: housing allowance|startup capital|additional funding|entrepreneurial support
facts.keywords: housing allowance|startup capital|additional funding|entrepreneurial support
facts.answer: Full-time arrangements may include housing support. Entrepreneurial projects may be considered for start-up capital or subsequent project funding, subject to the applicable programme and review.

facts.title: 项目组织层级
facts.questionVariants: responsible government organization|government body|sponsoring institution|talent office|government agency|ministry of science and technology
facts.keywords: responsible government organization|government body|sponsoring institution|talent office|government agency|ministry of science and technology
facts.answer: The programme is led at the national level by China's Ministry of Science and Technology and implemented locally by local government talent offices.

facts.title: 线上知识产权边界
facts.questionVariants: intellectual property|IP rights|who owns IP|IP ownership|IP arising|publication rights
facts.keywords: intellectual property|IP rights|who owns IP|IP ownership|IP arising|publication rights
facts.answer: Until a contract is signed, nothing you share with us transfers any rights; any final intellectual-property arrangements will be set out in the future written agreement.

facts.title: 联系信息来源
facts.questionVariants: how did you find me|where did you get my email|contact source
facts.keywords: how did you find me|where did you get my email|contact source
facts.answer: Potential candidates are identified through publicly available academic sources such as ORCID, research publications and university researcher profiles.

facts.title: 项目内容介绍
facts.questionVariants: what is this project|what is the program|about the programme|which programme
facts.keywords: what is this project|what is the program|about the programme|which programme
facts.answer: This is a government-backed programme connecting experienced international experts with Chinese enterprises for research and technology collaboration. At the introductory stage, no relocation or commitment is required.

facts.title: 项目总览
facts.questionVariants: learn more|programme structure|programme tracks|typical duration|advisory project
facts.keywords: learn more|programme structure|programme tracks|typical duration|advisory project
facts.answer:
Two tracks:

Innovative Talent Scheme -- for senior researchers (PhD + notable institutional experience) to serve as a research consultant to a matched Chinese enterprise. You would guide the company's R&D for 2-3 years, without leaving your current position. Most participants work remotely and visit China 1-2 times per year; all travel expenses are covered by us.

Entrepreneurial Talent Scheme -- for experts who wish to commercialize their research by establishing a venture in China. Remote involvement is possible, with 1-2 annual visits.

facts.title: 项目公开状态
facts.questionVariants: official programme name|programme website|publicly listed|official notice|project name|public website|confidential programme
facts.keywords: official programme name|programme website|publicly listed|official notice|project name|public website|confidential programme
facts.answer: The programme is confidential and therefore has no publicly disclosed official name and no public-facing official website.

facts.title: 顾问名单公开政策
facts.questionVariants: advisor list|adviser list|current advisors|participant list
facts.keywords: advisor list|adviser list|current advisors|participant list
facts.answer: For privacy and confidentiality reasons, a current adviser list is not published.

facts.title: 合作角色
facts.questionVariants: my role|position|consultant|adviser|co-entrepreneur
facts.keywords: my role|position|consultant|adviser|co-entrepreneur
facts.answer: Depending on the agreed project, the expert may serve as a research or technical adviser to the matched enterprise, or participate as a co-entrepreneur in a technology venture.

facts.title: 主要职责
facts.questionVariants: responsibilities|duties|what would I do|my responsibilities|technical advisor
facts.keywords: responsibilities|duties|what would I do|my responsibilities|technical advisor
facts.answer: Responsibilities depend on the project and may include technical guidance, research advice, problem-solving, product-development support or commercialisation guidance.

facts.title: 交付物
facts.questionVariants: deliverables|outputs|milestones|reports|expected work
facts.keywords: deliverables|outputs|milestones|reports|expected work
facts.answer: There is no universal deliverables list. Expected outputs, milestones, reports and other deliverables are negotiated with the matched enterprise and recorded in the written agreement.

facts.title: 全职、兼职及远程
facts.questionVariants: full time|part time|remote|form of collaboration|technical consultant
facts.keywords: full time|part time|remote|form of collaboration|technical consultant
facts.answer: Full-time, part-time and remote advisory arrangements may be possible. The applicable form depends on the enterprise, project scope and agreed workload.

facts.title: 现有单位、搬迁及赴华安排
facts.questionVariants: current affiliation|university affiliation|remain employed|relocate|move to China|visits|travel expenses|work location
facts.keywords: current affiliation|university affiliation|remain employed|relocate|move to China|visits|travel expenses|work location
facts.answer: A typical remote advisory arrangement does not require relocation or a change to the expert's current institutional affiliation. Short visits to China may be arranged where the project requires them, with travel support determined by the project arrangement.

facts.title: 合作期限及投入时间
facts.questionVariants: project duration|time commitment|weekly hours|monthly hours|how involved|duration for technical advisers
facts.keywords: project duration|time commitment|weekly hours|monthly hours|how involved|duration for technical advisers
facts.answer: A research advisory project commonly runs for approximately two to three years. Exact weekly or monthly workload is flexible and must be agreed with the matched enterprise.
